entities.name: Great Seljuk Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Great Seljuk Empire, a political institution in Iran during Islamic Iran and Persian Cultural Renaissance (1040–1220). Grew from Ferdowsi completes the Shahnameh (Book of Kings), the Persian national epic and Iranian Dynasties and Persian Revival. Led to the emergence of Omar Khayyam reforms the Persian calendar — more accurate than the Gregorian and Genghis Khan destroys Nishapur, Merv, and other major Iranian cities.
